1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 Bc5 4.b4 Bxb4 5..strategy: The usual follow-up to c3: the pawn takes the centre and attacks e5. The bishop on e7 cannot be hit by it, so White gains no tempo here, but the centre is big and Black must find a safe way to return the extra pawn.

Attacks the bishop on c4 at once, the move that the retreat to e7 made possible since a5 is free for the knight. Black gains time to challenge the centre and, if need be, to hand the pawn back for a solid game.
